welcome.reviewToast: Tips will show up again on each screen

where.title: Where everyone is going tonight
where.body: The map shows the city's hot spots: the purple circles are the venues with the most going on tonight, and the bigger they are the more people.

declare.title: Declare your night
declare.body: From the map to "I'm going" or "Maybe" in 3 taps. Your friends see you on the friends map.

points.bands: Never exact numbers: only ranges, and "few" under 3 people.
points.photo: Only your friends can see your photo.
points.chat: The night chat is deleted after 2 days.
points.posts: Posts and messages are deleted after 7 days.
points.location: Your location is used only if you turn it on.

map.viewToggle: Friends: where your friends are going. Maps: the city's hot spots.
map.hotSpot: Tap a venue to see who is going and declare your night.

topbar.plus: Tomorrow, post photos from the night: they are deleted after 7 days.

venue.declare: Declare your night: I'm going or Maybe.
venue.bands: We count in ranges, never individual people.

chat.night: The night chat is deleted after 2 days.

friends.search: Find friends by @handle and send a request.

profile.message: Message them privately: messages last 7 days.
